Senses.Explanation: The Shaanfu Iron Ox is the corpus's fixed place-named iron ox, distinct from an unplaced iron-ox figure. Chan masters make it an impossible moving stage-object and public answer. Fenyang Shanzhao answers a question about the student's turning place by saying to water the Shaanfu Iron Ox. Linxi Wenqing's hall address pairs it with the great image of Jiading and makes the two cross their named regions: the image comes through the pass while the Iron Ox enters western Shu. Baiyu Si says that a fire beneath Lake Tai frightens it into running to Silla. These place-name, pairing, watering, and travel predicates establish the recurring named object, but the stored witnesses do not establish what physical object it was or whether it was cast.
Senses.Note: The Shaanfu family appears throughout the concordance, but searches found no exact formula saying that the Shaanfu object itself was cast. The display therefore preserves the conventional name without supplying either 'cast' or 'landmark' as its definition. Repeated animations do not create additional senses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：如何是學人轉身處？師云：陝府灌鐵牛。問：如何是學人親切處？師云：河西弄師子。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continuation of the Lamp from the Jianzhong Jingguo Era (建中靖國續燈錄), section on Fenyang Shanzhao. Fenyang Shanzhao answers the student's turning-place question with watering the Shaanfu iron ox.

Occurrences.Kwic: 嘉州大像出關來。陝府鐵牛入西蜀。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Supplement to the Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), section on Linxi Wenqing. Linxi Wenqing makes the Jiading great image come through the pass and the Shaanfu iron ox enter western Shu; he is not yet in the current roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 嚇得陝府鐵牛走向新羅國裏去也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄), by Baiyu Si. Baiyu Si says that a fire beneath Lake Tai frightened the Shaanfu iron ox into running to Silla.

RelatedTerms: great image of Jiading (嘉州大像)

Senses.Explanation: An iron-ox figure is an unplaced ox image that Chan masters put into comparisons, mechanism language, and impossible actions. Yaoshan Weiyan compares his former position at Shitou Xiqian to a mosquito on an iron ox. Guishan Lingyou sharpens the physical scene: a mosquito on the iron ox has nowhere to put its mouth. Fengxue Yanzhao compares the patriarchal mind-seal to the mechanism of an iron ox and stages a public exchange over whether to apply the seal. Zhenjing Kewen has a hornless iron ox break an iron barrier, and Yandang Wenji places one in a lineage answer beside the barren woman who bears a child. Baichi Yuan's verse directly speaks of casting an iron ox, establishing a cast object in that occurrence without making casting part of every use. Hongzhi Zhengjue says one tug by the iron ox snaps a gold rope. These are deployments of the generic figure, not the specifically named Shaanfu Iron Ox.
Senses.Note: The direct casting witness establishes a cast object locally but does not make every generic iron ox cast, nor does it retroactively identify the Shaanfu Iron Ox's material relation. Fixed longer forms such as the mechanism of an iron ox and the hornless iron ox are retained as family deployments; they do not independently define the bare headword. Mosquito, seal, barrier, and lineage uses are predicates and comparisons, not separate referents.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。某甲在石頭處。如蚊子上鐵牛。祖曰。汝既如是。善自護持。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), section on Yaoshan Weiyan. Yaoshan Weiyan tells Mazu Daoyi that his position at Shitou Xiqian was like a mosquito on an iron ox.

Occurrences.Kwic: 聲前非聲。色後非色。蚊子上鐵牛。無汝下觜處。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), section on Guishan Lingyou. Guishan Lingyou says that a mosquito on an iron ox has nowhere to put its mouth.

Occurrences.Kwic: 祖師心印。狀似鐵牛之機。去即印住。住即印破。祇如不去不住。印即是。不印即是。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), Fengxue Yanzhao section. Fengxue Yanzhao compares the patriarchal mind-seal to the mechanism of an iron ox and contrasts going, staying, applying the seal, and breaking it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 石門巇嶮鐵關牢。舉目重重萬仞高。無角鐵牛衝得破。毘盧海內作波濤。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Supplement to the Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), section on Zhenjing Kewen. Zhenjing Kewen makes a hornless iron ox break through an iron barrier.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問。祖祖相傳傳祖印。師今得法嗣何人。師曰。無角鐵牛眠少室。生兒石女老黃梅。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Supplement to the Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), section on Yandang Wenji. Yandang Wenji answers a lineage question with a hornless iron ox sleeping at Shaoshi and a barren woman bearing a child; he is not yet in the current roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 力薄無能鑄鐵牛，長吟短詠倩君酬，庭前昨夜金梧墜，報道鷗灘一夏休。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baichi (百癡禪師語錄), by Baichi Yuan. Baichi Yuan says that his strength is too slight to cast an iron ox and offers his own closing-summer verse; he is not yet in the current roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 裏許牧童歸未歸。鐵牛一掣金繩斷。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Hongzhi (宏智禪師廣錄), by Hongzhi Zhengjue. Hongzhi Zhengjue asks whether the herdboy has returned and says one tug by the iron ox snaps the gold rope.
